text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, so far, so good! My running is 
getting better and better, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I keep this up, I know I can become 
that person! The one who stops countless 
tears with feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, guess I'll head to bed soon. Got 
to do my best tomorrow too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Huh... What is this... Am I dreaming...? 
Is this some kind of omen...? "Black" 
again?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(No, that's not it. "White" is there at 
the same time. "Black and White"—are the 
two opposing forces clashing?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What a strange dream... What was that? A 
symbol combining two differently colored 
magatama... What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's a "Taijitu," isn't it? I wonder 
what it was trying to show us.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Black and white... Will I... have to 
choose one over the other?

text_block_list.name: Rickey & Dia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Copano Rickey was running side 
by side with Satono Diamond."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Rickey-san, you're fast. Even 
though we ran on the turf course where I'm 
at my best today.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, this is nothing! Call it the 
pride of debuting first♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not as clear as the Voice of 
the Sand, I can pretty much hear the Voice 
of the Grass on the turf course now too☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her, a thought crossed my mind. 
We need to decide on our next goal soon, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's faint, as long as I can hear 
the voice of the grass—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I headed up to the spectator stands with 
a clear view of the training grounds. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes, what can I do for you?
choice_data_list: What did you think of Ricky's run on turf?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, how she runs on turf? Umm, judging 
by how she looked just now..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I realized I'm actually pretty good on 
turf! I was able to run right alongside 
Dia-chan, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey will soon enter the Classic 
Year. And the Classics mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's the well-known Classic Triple 
Crown. If we're considering a change of 
course, this might be our last chance.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, the Classic Triple Crown!? 
Challenging the biggest turf races!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it might be worth thinking about.
Yeah, it might be worth considering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spread feng shui and save people. In order 
to make Copano Rickey's goal come to 
fruition...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's certain that big races suit her 
better. When I tell her that—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, got it. If we can show off the 
power of feng shui in a big place...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
People will believe me much sooner that 
way. If all goes well, maybe I can save 
even more lives.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you can hear the voice of the turf, 
then perhaps such a path... The unknown 
stage is steadily being set.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Turf and dirt. Light and shadow. Two sides 
of the track. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's what "black and white" 
meant!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe this is an opportunity that was 
destined to come!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Once again, we should rethink the path we 
decided on before the debut.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if we're gonna decide, is this 
our last chance?
choice_data_list:
Probably. The Satsuki Sho is coming up 
soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, I'll need to think 
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt or turf—which path will lead to 
greater good fortune for the future?!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey stared intently at the book 
for a long time. However, the answer 
wouldn't come easily.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... I think I've got the gist of 
it now.
choice_data_list: Which one is better feng shui-wise?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um, honestly, as things stand— it's about 
fifty-fifty.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Black and white, neither yielding. Feels 
like each has its own pros and cons.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"At first glance, it might seem that way, 
right? But depending on how you look at 
it, there might still be something we can 
do, you know? Because—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to see everything in black 
and white. Our number one goal isn't just 
to enter *all* of the Classic Triple Crown 
races, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There are many ways for an Umamusume and 
Trainer to pair up, and many ways to 
intertwine their dreams. And..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey and I didn't team up to aim 
for the Classic Triple Crown. That much 
was certain.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I rush to switch to turf and can't 
bring out the power of feng shui, it'll 
all be for nothing. In the end, I won't be 
able to help anyone. So—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Proposal: How about we— "let the dragon 
submerge into the earth for now"?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, we'll hold off on deciding for now 
and pass on the Satsuki Sho. Instead—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Enter a major dirt race held around the 
same time to assess her aptitude and 
ability at this stage.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We'll lie low and scout things out! And 
there's a race that's just perfect for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey spread the race schedule 
across the table, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—The "Fukuryu Stakes." A dirt Open-class 
race held around the same time as the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the name, it's perfect for our 
goal this time! I think it'd be great to 
enter this one, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the suggestion, I think it over. 
True, there's no need to win the Satsuki 
Sho at all costs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then I decided it best to pass on that for 
now and run in a race that could provide 
better assessment data instead.
choice_data_list:
Alright, then let's enter the Fukuryu 
Stakes.

Alright, then let's enter the Fukuryu 
Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Then it's settled☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, you caught me totally off guard 
bringing up the Classic Triple Crown so 
out of the blue~.
choice_data_list: Sorry, did I make you lose your way?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, if that's how you felt, Trainer, then 
I'm sure your suggestion has a good reason 
behind it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't just a whim; it holds the 
power to change the future. Yes, this is 
the stepping stone toward a new tide. 
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Keep telling me everything you think, 
feel, and wonder about from now on, okay? 
Your voice is sure to save someone in the 
future!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Don't forget. You're an important part of 
the 'environment' that decides my path 
forward, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to think it was a meaningful 
suggestion in its own way. And so, Copano 
Rickey decided to aim for the Fukuryu 
Stakes.
